notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-102. Values from the transcript (04:31-05:16): Type Vertical Box; region 0 header, length 4, form units, orientation Fill; region 1 main, length 1, flex unit, Fill; region 2 footer, length 2, form units, Fill; then OK.
